answer: Each identity plants a lotus beacon post, locking 70 credits. Each epoch the beacon posts a juniper-marked value decaying in hours, so no receipt stockpiles. Each identity files a quill-signed receipt of work tied to that value; auditors check it, and stale or rented receipts burn the bond. First costs 42, the k-th 42+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 42 once and keep their share.
